response.sql:
WITH per_reference AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) AS execution_count
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
), shares AS (
  SELECT ordersmark,
         execution_count,
         execution_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(execution_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM per_reference
), deviations AS (
  SELECT ordersmark,
         execution_count,
         share,
         share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_average
  FROM shares
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC NULLS LAST) AS place
  FROM deviations
)
SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, share, share_minus_average
FROM ranked
WHERE place <= 10
ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC NULLS LAST;

assumptions.assumption: The average share is the unweighted arithmetic mean of the per-reference shares, with all NULL ordersmark executions grouped together as one reference. SQL NULLS LAST applies to the difference; when there are no executions, the result is empty.
